brief.zh: 又一个黑箱。它只会输出 0 和 1。用测试图喂它，找出它在多亮的地方从 0 变成 1。
brief.en: Another black box. It only ever outputs 0 or 1. Feed it test images and find how bright a cell must be before it turns from 0 to 1.

after.zh: 正确。你得到了<part-ref to="threshold"></part-ref>：大于门槛 t 的格子变 1，其余变 0，t 由你来定。只有 0 和 1 的图叫掩膜，用来标出图里的某块区域。
after.en: Correct. You now have <part-ref to="threshold"></part-ref>: cells above the threshold t become 1 and the rest 0, and you choose t. An image of only 0s and 1s is called a mask; it marks out a region of the picture.

t.zh: 很多问题要的答案只有「是」或「否」：这一格是不是路面？这里有没有人？深浅不一的灰，得变成 0 和 1。
t.en: Many questions want a yes or a no: is this cell road? Is anyone here? Shades of grey have to become 0s and 1s.

t.zh: 台上是一个黑箱，它只会输出 0 和 1。喂它不同的测试图，看哪些格子变成了 1，哪些变成了 0。
t.en: There is a black box on the bench, and it only ever outputs 0 or 1. Feed it different test pictures and see which cells become 1 and which become 0.

t.zh: 要想的问题：哪张测试图最容易读出它的规则？点一下格子（电脑上把鼠标停在上面），可以读出它原来的亮度。这个元件过关后也归你。
t.en: Something to think about: which test picture reveals its rule most easily? Tap a cell (or point at it on a computer) to read its original brightness. Once you pass, this part is yours too.

question.zh: 亮度要超过多少，它才输出 1？
question.en: How bright must a cell be before it outputs 1?

wrong.zh: 用斜坡试：点一下从 0 变 1 的那两格，读出它们原来的亮度。
wrong.en: Try the ramp: tap the two cells where 0 turns into 1 and read their original brightness.
